policy: A named, reviewed acceptance that lowers the frozen-output shrink floor for one route, written against one frozen sha256. Read by scripts/authority_scale/frozen_output_shrink.mjs; enforced at pull-request time by validate:frozen-output-shrink; retired by frozen_outputs.mjs freeze once the frozen baseline it names has moved.

acceptances.reason: #107 (2026-09-25) replaced this post's boilerplate description '- a calm, executable framework (Spry Executive OS).' with page-specific text. The longer text puts the page over the word-count floor, so auto_expand_short_pages.js drops its generic 'Implementation notes' filler (data-content-contract=word-count-repair), and the visible FAQ built from page sections loses the question that filler supplied and falls below three questions, so build_visible_faq_sections.py drops it. Everything lost is generated filler or boilerplate repeated from the old description; no authored content is removed. Floor is the smaller of the committed page after #107 and the converged page measured by Daily Citation Intelligence run 36245956232 and a local agent-intake replay.
